common: Animate THIS exact image. Keep exactly the same chibi characters (same faces, same eyes, same hair, same clothes, same body sizes), same background, same flat pastel cartoon style as the input image. Static locked-off shot, no zoom, no camera movement. Nobody talks to the camera: mouths are smiling, laughing or still unless stated. Natural gentle movements, nobody jumps around. Do not add any text, letters, numbers, people or new objects. Do NOT add any sparkles, stars, glitter, light bursts or glow effects.

clips.K1: The young father taps the calculator buttons slowly and thoughtfully, the mother writes a few lines in her notebook, then they glance at each other and nod calmly. The little boy on the rug carefully places one more toy block on top of his tower and smiles proudly.
clips.K2: The couple on the sofa hold the school brochure together, look down at it, then turn to look at each other and both nod with a warm, decided smile. Gentle small movements, they sit upright.
clips.K3: The children paint at their easels: the little boy in front dips his brush in the palette and adds a petal to his flower painting with a happy smile; the classmates behind him keep painting calmly and smile.
clips.K4: The little boy kicks the football forward with a happy laugh and runs after it at a natural child pace; his classmates jog along beside him laughing. Natural running, nobody falls.
clips.K5: The kind teacher gently pats the little boy's head twice; he looks up at her and grins happily; the classmates around him laugh and chat with each other, mouths moving a little.
clips.K6: The little boy holds out his open lunch box toward the sad girl and nods kindly; she wipes her tear with one hand, then smiles and reaches toward the lunch box. Gentle, slow movements.
clips.K7: The little boy points at the planet poster on the blackboard and explains happily, his mouth moving; his two teammates nod and smile; the teacher and the seated classmates clap gently. The poster stays fixed on the board.
clips.K8: The teacher holds up the apple picture card; the little boy shoots his hand up first with an excited smile, and a moment later the other classmates raise their hands too. The teacher smiles and points at the boy.
clips.K9: The kneeling boy slowly moves the magnifying glass closer to the ladybug on the leaf, his eyes widen with wonder and he gasps happily; the ladybug crawls a little along the leaf; the girl beside him leans in curiously and smiles.
clips.K10: The mother points at the shapes on the small whiteboard and explains gently, her mouth moving; the girl nods and draws in her book with the pencil; the father turns a page of his open book and smiles at the girl.
clips.K11: The parents hurry to leave for work: the father glances at the small watch on his left wrist and turns toward the door, the mother sips her coffee quickly and adjusts her shoulder bag; both wave a quick goodbye toward the little boy, who waves back holding his toy dinosaur. Walking, not running.
clips.K12: The couple stare at the phone screen in shock: eyes widen even more, mouths open in a round 'O', the mother slowly presses her hand to her cheek, the father scratches the back of his head and blinks; then they slowly turn to look at each other in disbelief. Funny surprise, not angry.
clips.K13: The stressed mother types fast on the laptop during the video meeting, glancing anxiously back over her shoulder at the pot that bubbles over more and more on the stove; her little son, facing her the whole time, lifts his homework sheet up toward her and taps her arm to get her attention. She stays seated, frowning and flustered. The boy keeps facing his mother.
clips.K14: Late at night on the sofa, the mother slumps back further with her eyes squeezed shut and rubs her temples slowly with both hands as if she has a headache, sighing deeply; the father beside her rubs his forehead with one hand and lets out a tired sigh, his shoulders drop. Slow, heavy movements.
clips.K15: The parents walk the little boy toward the school gate holding his hands; at the gate they let go, the boy turns and waves goodbye happily, and the parents smile proudly and wave back. Walking at a normal pace.
clips.K13b: With the oven mitt the flustered mother quickly lifts the boiling-over pot off the burner, steam puffing up; she glances back worriedly at the laptop on the desk where the meeting is still going and the phone keeps buzzing; her little son, facing her the whole time, holds his homework sheet up toward her and waits. Quick but natural movements, nothing is spilled on anyone.
